findings.label: A model can make its own Source a fallback candidate
findings.detail: older_spelling_candidates trusts any Note.import.source. prepare_changes validation rejects only Run, Settings, Asset, Message and ChatControl writes; materialize_selected_sources rewrites note.import only when a host-supplied source is selected; the core checks only that import.source names a Source. A model can therefore create a Source plus a Note whose non-full import names it, and that Source is then resolved by realpath and can be adopted (and respelled) by begin() for another spelling of a host-supplied file in the same scope. The verification.md limitations 'Paths that only a model named are never resolved' and 'A Source only a model named, under an older spelling of a file, is not matched' overstate this.
findings.action: Reword the two limitations in round5/verification.md to say a model can still bring a Source it named into the older-spelling match by naming it in a Note's import. Restricting candidates to full_note imports would break Keep in BRN of a useful note.

findings.label: respelled_source reads the filesystem inside apply's write transaction
findings.detail: respelled_source runs in apply_on's refresh loop with the write transaction open and calls canonical_locator on both locators of any Source whose only meaningful change is its locator. Besides the host respell, this includes a model's locator edit to a Source it named (allowed for non-host-observed Sources) and owner edits. A stalled network path blocks realpath while desktop, CLI and agent writes wait on the lock.
findings.action: Add to the slice B limitations that this read happens with the store's write lock held and that a model's or owner's locator edit can trigger it.

findings.label: Longest-prefix choice in the retained-scope fallback is untested
findings.detail: The B-R4 test's issue locator has one ' · ' separator, so replacing .last() with .next() in retained_useful_report's canonical prefix fallback leaves the suite green.
findings.action: Add a respelled issue locator with a second separator to requalifying_a_source_respelled_since_an_older_build_drops_its_retained_omission, or accept the gap.
